title: AMCP Transaction Anchor
description: One interoperable object binding the eight primitives (identity, capability, intent, authorization, commitment, receipt, evidence, dispute) plus composed payment/settlement stages. Sections reference each other by id/hash and are append-only in time: later sections annotate, never edit, earlier ones. See spec/disputes.md §7. AMCP v0.1.

identity.description: Parties: claimant-side principal, counterparty, agents/humans involved. Keys live in descriptors, referenced by id.

capability.description: What was provided/done. Mirrors a descriptor capability entry by id, not by value.

intent.description: Requested outcome: action, constraints, budget ceiling. Frontier: request-for-quote broadcast.

authorization_chain.description: Ordered grants, principal-first. Each link monotonically restricts the previous: scope, limits, expiry. See VISION.md §8.

consent.description: Authoritative decisions at human-approval boundaries. Unified with decision receipts: one object, not two.

commitment.description: What the parties agreed: terms hash + bilateral signatures. Mirrors contract.schema.json by contract_id.

payment.description: Composed payment stage (x402). AMCP records authorization linkage, never moves money.

execution.description: Where/how work ran (session/room/task refs). AMCP does not constrain the execution substrate.

receipt.description: Signed portable proof. References receipt.schema.json by receipt_id.

evidence.description: Source-keyed evidence refs (hash/URI). Audit everything; rank only the understood.

verification.description: Acceptance evaluation against commitment criteria. Frontier: executed (not just schemad) verdicts.

settlement.description: Ledger outcome: escrow transitions, disbursement records. Ledger-only; disbursement is out of scope.

reputation.description: Projected evidence refs + reputation-v1 snapshot version. Never a private score as source data.

dispute.description: References dispute.schema.json by dispute_id. Terminal dispute states feed reputation and close.
